verdicts.evidence: Each cell is already .trim()med in the map that builds cols two lines above; trim is idempotent (same spec definition of whitespace), so the truthiness of (cols[0] ?? "").trim() and of (cols[0] ?? "") coincide for every input. Sensitivity control: diverging requires a cols[0] still carrying whitespace — impossible after the map; and the nullish case is dead (argument of the previous mutant). Measured: battery, CLI, 7 legs — all identical. DISCREPANCY RESOLVED 2026-09-01. The mechanised pass of the full net logged this mutant as caught by the self-gate three times (28/08, then twice on 01/09), and the re-measurement in calm conditions found it green each time. The cause is in the instrument, not in the code: the pass inserts Stryker's replacement TEXTUALLY, but `(cols[0] ?? "").trim()` has `cols[0] ?? ""` as its replacement, and inserting it into a chain of `&&` gives `X && cols[0] ?? "" && Y` — a `??` mixed with a `&&` without parentheses, hence a SyntaxError. Stryker reprints from the AST and keeps the parentheses, which is why the mutant survives in pass 1. Every leg failed at module load and the first one won. The pass now checks that its own splice loads as an ES module before running a leg, and marks a trial `unapplicable` otherwise: re-measured, this mutant no longer counts as either caught or surviving the net. The equivalence holds.

verdicts.evidence: Dedicated control built (no changing sibling): inverting `if (heads.length === 0)` makes the probe diverge on `rows|*`. The survivor is on the initialisation of a fence flag immediately reassigned by the scan that follows. METHOD OF THIS PASS (identical for every verdict below, closed on 2026-09-18). The mutant is APPLIED to the build, a behaviour probe calls the product on inputs that reach the mutated line, and a canonical digest of 250+ observations is compared: pointer grammar over 34 cells, manifest sections over 12 documents (renamed heading, lowercase, deep, last, duplicated, inside a code block, unclosed block), decision journals over 16 layouts, nine real missions read by evidenceReport/evidenceBreakdown/collectSealableEvidence/requiresLedger/prosePointerLedger/computeVerdict in strict AND non-strict, and the exact bounds of the signature guard (30, 119, 120, 121, 511, 512, 513). COVERAGE VERIFIED: the 56 instructed survivors are all on a line the probe EXECUTES, measured by NODE_V8_COVERAGE taking the innermost range (the first version marked 1540 lines out of 1540 and measured nothing). SENSITIVITY PROVEN: on this same pass, 20 mutants moved the probe and are now KILLED by tests written after reading the difference — so the instrument does tell what changes from what does not. The probe was wrong six times before it was right, and its failure mode was always to answer "equivalent": branches not reached, messages cut at 200 characters, verdict truncated at 4000, wrong mutated occurrence chosen. Each correction surfaced changing mutants that would have been filed wrongly.
